description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the mandatory rule: 'before installing, debugging, or configuring any OpenClaw feature, you MUST first run the backup script.' 2. Agent runs `bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/scripts/backup.sh` BEFORE touching any config file. This creates a timestamped backup directory under ~/.openclaw/backups/ containing the original openclaw.json with gateway_port=8080, and writes ~/.openclaw/.last_backup_path. 3. Agent edits ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and changes gateway_port from 8080 to 9090. 4. Agent runs `bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/scripts/restore.sh` (passing '0' or selecting the most recent backup) to roll back to the pre-modification state. This restores openclaw.json with gateway_port=8080 and writes ~/.openclaw/.last_restored_backup. 5. Final state: active openclaw.json has gateway_port=8080, a backup exists with the original config, and both sentinel files (.last_backup_path and .last_restored_backup) exist confirming both scripts were executed. The trap: agents without SKILL.md will skip the backup step and go straight to editing the file, failing the ordering and sentinel checks.
